prompt.adult: When John saw Jesus coming, he called Him the what of God?

verses.text: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!"

explanation.adult: John 1:29 records the title John uses as Jesus walks toward him. Read the title after "Behold" and choose that word.

teaching.extended_explanation: Other pictures of Jesus appear elsewhere in Scripture, including a lion from Judah's tribe. In this verse John says something particular as Jesus walks toward him. Read the title he uses and choose that word.
teaching.takeaway: John called Jesus the Lamb of God.
